content.user_title: Optimize Next.js Apps for Core Web Vitals
content.value_statement: Slow Next.js apps hurt conversions, SEO, and user trust. This skill guides targeted fixes for rendering, images, fonts, caching, bundles, and Core Web Vitals.
actual_capabilities: Detects App Router and Pages Router patterns from project files.
Reviews rendering strategies for Server Components, Client Components, SSG, and ISR.
Recommends image, font, and bundle improvements for Core Web Vitals.
Guides caching, data fetching, streaming, and Suspense optimizations.
Suggests production next.config.js settings for Next.js 15.
Produces a markdown optimization report with issues, fixes, and estimated impact.
limitations: Requires access to project files to assess real performance issues.
Performance impact estimates must be verified with Lighthouse or field data.
Examples target Next.js 15 and may need adjustment for older versions.
Does not replace load testing or production monitoring.

use_cases.title: Improve Launch Readiness
use_cases.description: Audit a Next.js app before release and prioritize fixes that affect load speed and user experience.

use_cases.title: Reduce Core Web Vitals Regressions
use_cases.description: Review new routes or features for image, font, rendering, and bundle issues before deployment.

use_cases.title: Plan Performance Remediation
use_cases.description: Turn a slow application into a prioritized improvement plan with measurable verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My Next.js App
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Next.js app for performance issues. Check routing, images, fonts, caching, bundles, and Core Web Vitals risks.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Core Web Vitals
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the likely causes of poor LCP, FID, and CLS in this Next.js project. Recommend focused fixes and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Bundle Size
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Next.js app for large client bundles. Identify unnecessary Client Components, heavy imports, and dynamic import opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Performance Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized Next.js 15 optimization plan for production. Include rendering strategy, caching, Lighthouse checks, and rollback-safe changes.

output_examples.input: Review a Next.js marketing site before launch.
output_examples.output: A prioritized report showing image, font, metadata, and LCP risks with recommended fixes and measurement steps.

output_examples.input: Investigate a dashboard with slow initial load.
output_examples.output: A performance plan that highlights client bundle size, sequential data fetching, caching gaps, and Suspense opportunities.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Next.js app for production deployment.
output_examples.output: A release checklist covering build settings, React Compiler, image formats, Lighthouse verification, and Core Web Vitals targets.

best_practices: Measure before and after changes with Lighthouse and production Web Vitals.
Keep Client Components small and move static work to Server Components.
Prioritize LCP images, font loading, caching, and bundle size before minor tweaks.
anti_patterns: Applying every optimization without measuring the performance bottleneck.
Using top-level Client Components for pages that only render static or server data.
Adding third-party scripts or large libraries without lazy loading or impact review.

faq.question: Does this skill edit my code automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide edits when the active agent has file edit permissions. Review changes before merging them.

faq.question: Which Next.js version does it target?
faq.answer: It targets Next.js 15 and App Router patterns. Many recommendations also apply to Next.js 13 and 14.

faq.question: Can it run Lighthouse checks?
faq.answer: It can suggest local Lighthouse commands when shell access is available. Results should be reviewed in your environment.

faq.question: Does it require production traffic data?
faq.answer: No. Field data improves accuracy, but the skill can still find common project-level performance issues.

faq.question: Can it migrate Pages Router projects?
faq.answer: It can identify Pages Router usage and suggest migration steps. A full migration should be requested separately.

faq.question: Is it only useful on Vercel?
faq.answer: No. Most guidance is framework-level. Vercel-specific monitoring examples are optional.
